solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Cut short acrimony — compromise

parts.note: to cut something short is to end it
acrimony is bitterness or anger

explanation.surface: A bitter quarrel ends abruptly in a compromise between the parties.
explanation.definitionFit: To compromise someone's safety is to put it at risk, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Spent two notes at the gala

parts.note: E is a musical note
F is another musical note
a fete is a festive gala

explanation.surface: A guest spent a couple of banknotes at the summer gala.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Notes' suggests money, but it means musical notes E and F.
explanation.definitionFit: Effete means worn out and exhausted, as is something spent.

clue.text: Ill-judgment

parts.note: reads as poor judgment, but means a judgment about illness

explanation.definitionFit: A doctor's identification of a disease is a judgment on an illness.

clue.text: Innocent one in church body

indicators.note: in means the numeral sits inside the church part

parts.note: the nave is the main body of a church
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A guileless person sits among the congregation.
explanation.definitionFit: Naive means artless and unworldly, a synonym of innocent.

clue.text: Obscure point repeated about prunes

indicators.note: about means the doubled compass letter goes around the trimming word
repeated means the compass letter appears twice

parts.note: E, east, is a compass point
to prune is to clip, so prunes means clips

explanation.surface: A gardener makes an obscure point, again and again, about pruning.
explanation.definitionFit: To eclipse is to obscure or overshadow, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Decorated about noon, has to deliver speech

indicators.note: about means the speechmaking word goes around the letter for noon

parts.note: to orate is to deliver a speech

explanation.surface: A dignitary, all dressed up around midday, is due to give an address.
explanation.definitionFit: Something decorated is elaborately adorned, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: In part, one sets a good example

definitions.text: In part, one sets a good example

parts.words: In part, one sets a good example
parts.note: an actor in a part plays a character, but here someone sets an example to admire

explanation.definitionFit: A person others look up to and imitate is an exemplar of good behaviour.

clue.text: A scholar rising, snapped — there are limits

indicators.note: in a down answer rising means the letters read upwards

parts.note: an MA, Master of Arts, is a scholar
bit means snapped, as a dog does

explanation.surface: A scholar gets up and snaps that there are limits.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambit is the scope or bounds of something, its extent.

clue.text: Went into service?

parts.note: reads as becoming a servant, but means joining the armed services

explanation.definitionFit: To sign up for the armed forces is to join military service.

clue.text: Changing a belief's not impossible

indicators.note: changing tells us the letters of the next words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone argues it is quite possible to change what you believe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Changing' rearranges A BELIEFS (the possessive 's counts as a letter here) into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Feasible means practicable or possible, so a synonym of not impossible.

clue.text: Going round the world is a smashing opportunity for a girl to take in

indicators.note: to take in means the word for girl holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl
a lob in tennis gives the opponent a chance to hit a smash

explanation.surface: A young woman is offered a fantastic chance to travel round the world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smashing' looks like praise, but it refers to the tennis smash a lob invites.
explanation.definitionFit: Global means worldwide, encompassing the whole planet, a looser synonym.

clue.text: It jumps and it's said to run

indicators.note: it's said signals a word that sounds like another

parts.note: to flee is to run away

explanation.surface: Something that hops about is also rumoured to escape.
explanation.definitionFit: A flea is a parasitic insect famous for its leaping.

clue.text: Worried for the future, perhaps

definitions.meaning: worried as in anxious or on edge
the future is one grammatical form a verb can take, alongside past and present

explanation.definitionFit: Tense means nervous, and grammatically future is an example of a verb form.

clue.text: College course for all-rounders

parts.note: poly is short for polytechnic, a type of British college
maths is a course of study

explanation.surface: A college offers a programme designed for versatile students.
explanation.definitionFit: Polymaths are people of wide learning, figuratively all-round experts.

clue.text: A horse being exercised on the beach

indicators.note: a horse being exercised is moved about, so its letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: A horse is given a gallop along the sand.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashore means on land by the sea, which describes being on the beach.

clue.text: Exaggerated account discredited

definitions.meaning: a bank account in debit, beyond its funds

explanation.definitionFit: A character overstated is overdone; a bank account in the red has gone past its limit.

clue.text: Bail due for release, it's heard

indicators.note: release suggests the letters are freed and set out anew

explanation.surface: Bail is due so a prisoner can be released, and it is announced.
explanation.definitionFit: Audible means capable of being heard, an adjectival match.

clue.text: Veto using proportional representation?

parts.note: a vote cast in bulk on behalf of members, weighted by numbers

explanation.definitionFit: A union delegate casting votes for all members weighted by membership is the system meant.

clue.text: Guard ordered to breached line

parts.note: ordered off means sent away

indicators.note: breached means the letters are broken and rearranged

explanation.surface: A guard is ordered to the front where the defences have been broken.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentinel is a soldier on watch, a synonym of guard.

clue.text: Point behind the ship towards the sun

parts.note: E, east, is a compass point
astern means behind a vessel

explanation.surface: A sailor indicates something trailing behind the ship as it heads into the sunrise.
explanation.definitionFit: Eastern means lying toward the east, where the sun rises.

clue.text: To expose a lie it needs hammering home

definitions.meaning: to show up a falsehood decisively
a metal spike driven in by a hammer

explanation.definitionFit: To expose something false is an idiomatic sense; a spike driven by a hammer is the fastener.

clue.text: Sarah depressed, rather jaundiced

parts.note: Sal is a familiar form of the name Sarah
low means depressed in spirits

explanation.surface: Sarah is feeling down and looks somewhat yellow and unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: Sallow describes a sickly yellowish complexion, like mild jaundice.

clue.text: The last sort of quality needed by cat burglars

indicators.note: sort means the letters are sorted into a new order

explanation.surface: The last thing a cat burglar needs is to be heard.
explanation.definitionFit: Stealth is secrecy and silent movement, essential to a burglar.

clue.text: Provided inside information about a complaint

definitions.text: Provided inside information about a complaint

parts.words: Provided inside information about a complaint
parts.note: reads like insider dealing or leaks, but describes a medical scan

explanation.definitionFit: A radiograph shows the inside of a body to diagnose an ailment.

clue.text: Evaluate performance of stroke on the river

indicators.note: in an across answer one piece on another follows it

parts.note: the Test is a river in Hampshire, southern England
a drive is a stroke in golf or cricket

explanation.surface: A rowing coach assesses how a crew member's stroke performs on the river.
explanation.walkthrough: The rowing picture is false: the river is the Test, a Hampshire trout river.
explanation.definitionFit: A test drive is a trial of a car's performance before buying it.

clue.text: Pushing forwards

parts.note: rugby forwards push against each other in a set formation

explanation.definitionFit: In rugby the forwards bind together and push for the ball in this set piece.

clue.text: He accepts Kate is upset, right?

indicators.note: upset means the name is knocked into disorder

explanation.surface: A man asks whether Kate is annoyed, and he accepts it.
explanation.definitionFit: One who accepts something offered is a recipient of it.

clue.text: Tether that is restricting ram? Quite the contrary

indicators.note: restricting means one piece hems the other in
the contrary means the roles are swapped so the ram does the restricting

parts.note: a tup is a ram

explanation.surface: A farmer wonders whether a rope is restraining the ram, or the reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie-up is a fastening or mooring, so a tether.

clue.text: No right way to see the country

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone complains there is no proper way to tour the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway is a Scandinavian nation, an example of a country.

clue.text: Go really wild with Pilgrim's Progress for example

indicators.note: wild means the letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: An enthusiastic reader raves about Bunyan's famous book.
explanation.walkthrough: Pilgrim's Progress is John Bunyan's 17th-century religious tale of a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pilgrim's Progress is a famous symbolic narrative, an example of the genre.

clue.text: Layer backs a horse, for example

indicators.note: backs means the word is read from end to start

parts.note: a horse is an example of an animal

explanation.surface: A gambler, or a hen that lays, backs a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Layer' and 'backs' suggest betting, but layer is a thin sheet.
explanation.definitionFit: A lamina is a thin plate or sheet, a technical synonym.

clue.text: The lamb's tender

parts.note: tender reads as gentle meat, but means one who tends the lamb

explanation.definitionFit: The person who tends a flock of sheep, lambs included, is its keeper.
